## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (6)
- `GET /api/chatsvc/amer/v1/users/ME/conversations/{conversationToken}` — Get a specific conversation.
- `GET /teams-modular-packages/hashed-assets/{hashed-assetToken}` — Retrieve hashed assets.
- `GET /trap/tokens` — Obtain tokens for authentication.
- `POST /api/authsvc/v1.0/authz` — Authorize access to Teams resources.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}/aadtokenauth` — Authenticate using an Azure AD token.
- `POST /v1/skypetokenauth` — Authenticate and obtain a Skype token.

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /api/csa/amer/api/v1/teams/users/me/pinnedChannels` — Get the user's pinned channels.
- `GET /api/csa/amer/api/v3/teams/users/me/updates` — Fetch updates for the current user.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/atpsafelinks/getpolicy/` — Get ATP Safe Links policy for the user.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/me/engagementSurfaces` — Get user engagement surfaces (e.g., features, tips).
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/users/{userId}` — Retrieve details for a specific user by ID.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/users/apps/usage` — Get user app usage data.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/userSettings/breakthroughlist` — Get user's breakthrough list settings.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/usersettings/useEndToEndEncryption` — Check if end-to-end encryption is enabled for the user.
- `GET /api/shell/navbardata` — Get navigation bar data.
- `POST /ups/noam/v1/presence/getpresence/` — Get user presence information.

### Data Write (8)
- `POST /api/mt/amer/beta/users/{userId}` — Update user information.
- `POST /api/mt/amer/beta/users/{userId}/cookiev2` — Set a user's cookie.
- `POST /api/mt/amer/beta/users/apps/batchedDefinitions` — Define batched application definitions for users.
- `POST /common/instrumentation/reportbssotelemetry` — Report BSSO telemetry data.
- `POST /OneCollector/1.0/` — Send telemetry data to Microsoft.
- `POST /registrar/prod/V2/registrations` — Register a new Teams client or application.
- `POST /ups/noam/v1/pubsub/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` — Manage pubsub subscriptions.
- `PUT /ups/noam/v1/me/endpoints/` — Update user endpoint information.

### Search (1)
- `GET /api/mt/amer/v2.0/places/findPlaces` — Find places based on search criteria.

### Config (4)
- `GET /admin/api/uxversion` — Get the current UX version.
- `GET /api/mt/amer/beta/me/settings/meetingConfiguration` — Retrieve meeting configuration settings for the user.
- `GET /api/v1/livepersonacard/configuration` — Get live persona card configuration.
- `GET /config/v1/{v1Id}/1415_1.0.0.0` — Retrieve a specific configuration file.
